title: apply_contract_context input
description: Input for apply_contract_context. Merge provides, host_aliases and explicit bindings in the existing repos.yaml format. Bindings select exactly one current consumer and an existing compatible endpoint. Dry-run by default; snapshot must be live.

service.description: A declared service, or an implicit repo-id service.

key.description: Endpoint key in the shared grammar, e.g. `http:POST /chat/stream`.

source.description: Where the declaration came from. Free-form.

host.description: The host expression as the analyzer records it (`HostPart::Expr`), e.g. `UPSTREAM_HTTP_ORIGIN`.

file.description: A repo-relative file. Every HTTP call in it whose host is unknown dials `service`.

service.description: A declared service, or an implicit repo-id service.

source.description: Where the mapping was established. Free-form.

dry_run.description: When true (the default), return the YAML that would be written and touch nothing.

bindings.description: Explicit confirmed mappings using existing repos.yaml bindings entries. The repo/path/symbol/key selector must match exactly one current consumer; fanout is refused. Conflicting destinations are errors; identical mappings are idempotent. Apply revalidates current facts independently of check_binding. Confirmed means declared, not human-approved.
